'''Denharad''' is the Lance-Captain of [[Ailil Riatin]]'s forces. 

== Appearance ==
He is a pale little man.

== Activities ==
He is in [[Rand al'Thor]]'s army which fight against the [[Seanchan]] trying to invade [[Illian]].
